description: Reads the raw bits of an input voltage as four step counts and walks them north, east, south and west over a four by eight grid, putting every cell out as its own voltage

params.text: While on, a byte is taken as one run of that many steps; while off, its eight bits are walked one at a time, a single step for each bit that is set
While on, a cell visited by the walk is switched rather than counted, and the outputs are either off or full; while off, visits are counted and scaled by Scale
While off, the input voltage is rounded up to a whole volt before its bits are read
While off, a cell's counted value is held at its top rather than wrapping around when the scale takes it past the top
Multiplies how much a cell's count is worth at its output, 1 to 256
Rotates the bits of the input voltage before they are split into the four step counts, -31 to 32 places
Slews every cell output, from an instant jump at zero to a slow glide at full
While on, the cell outputs run 0-10V; while off they run -5V to 5V
Sets where the walk starts, 0 to 32 cells counted across the grid

inputs.text: The voltage whose bits are read as the four step counts
Adds to the scale, 0-10V spanning the whole range
Adds to the rotation, -5V to 5V spanning 31 places either way
With a cable patched here, the input voltage is sampled on each rising edge and held until the next; with nothing patched the walk follows the input continuously
Shifts the starting cell, 0-10V across the whole grid, added to the Orig knob

outputs.text: Carries the value of its cell of the grid, one output per cell
